scope: Catalog references plus verified local acquisition status. Scientific derived features, scores and render assets are not yet produced. Challenge-list membership and provider evidence are separate.

sources.title: LRO LOLA Gridded Data Records
sources.provider: NASA PDS Geosciences Node / LOLA Science Team
sources.scope: Lunar elevation products from laser altimetry.
limitations: Read the selected product label for scale, offset, reference radius, coordinate system and nodata.
Slope and roughness must be derived for an explicit ROI and physical analysis scale; no crater-wide topographic constants are supplied by this registry.

sources.title: Improved LOLA Elevation Maps for South Pole Landing Sites
sources.provider: NASA Goddard Planetary Geodynamics Data Archive
sources.scope: Site-specific lunar south-pole elevation TIFFs and associated methodology.
limitations: Select a file whose footprint covers the actual ROI.
A site name does not establish a verified landing coordinate or thermal environment.

sources.title: LRO Diviner archives and global/polar temperature maps
sources.provider: NASA PDS Geosciences Node / UCLA Diviner Science Team
limitations: Record temperature definition, units, quality flags, temporal coverage and aggregation.
Cannot directly score against Earth two-metre air temperature.
The polar-directory URL is linked by the instrument team, but direct access timed out during source discovery.

sources.title: MGS MOLA Mission Experiment Gridded Data Record
sources.scope: Gridded Mars radius, areoid, topography and observation-count products.
limitations: Topography, radius and areoid are distinct products; inspect labels before conversion.
Do not compare slope values computed at incompatible DEM resolutions.

sources.title: HiRISE Candidate Landing Site for 2020 Mission in Jezero Crater DTM
sources.scope: A verified Jezero stereo DTM catalog entry with associated orthoimages.
limitations: The catalog identifies product DTEEC_045994_1985_046060_1985_U01; it has not been selected, downloaded, clipped or measured by this project.
Image or DTM centers are not the Perseverance landing coordinate.
The archive supplies no asserted ready-made Gaussian splat asset.

sources.title: Shuttle Radar Topography Mission
sources.scope: Earth elevation; this catalog reference describes the DTED-1 product, not an assertion that a 1-arcsecond tile has been acquired.
limitations: Coverage is 60 degrees north to 56 degrees south.
McMurdo Dry Valleys and Iceland Highlands are outside SRTM coverage; never substitute invented SRTM measurements.
Select and record the exact product/version, horizontal and vertical datums, resolution and quality mask before processing.

sources.title: ArcticDEM and Reference Elevation Model of Antarctica
sources.provider: Polar Geospatial Center and project partners
sources.scope: Candidate open polar-elevation sources for Antarctica and Iceland where SRTM is absent.
limitations: These are not SRTM products and must retain their own attribution.
Acquire only required tiles, check masks, datum and observation dates, and verify distribution terms for the selected product.
A mosaic can combine multiple acquisition dates.

sources.title: NASA POWER Daily API
sources.provider: NASA Langley Research Center POWER Project
sources.scope: Earth meteorological and solar-radiation time series for explicit locations and dates.
limitations: T2M_MIN/MAX are two-metre air-temperature quantities, not lunar surface temperature.
RH2M is relative humidity, not the P/PET aridity index.
Read parameter units and fill values from each API response; do not assume all communities use identical radiation units.
A point query samples a source grid cell; it is not automatically a fine-resolution polygon average.

sources.title: MODIS/Terra+Aqua MCD43A3 Collection 6.1 BRDF/Albedo
sources.scope: Earth surface albedo products with defined spectral bands and illumination conventions.
limitations: Black-sky, white-sky and different spectral-band albedos cannot be freely interchanged.
Record QA, temporal compositing, band, scale factor and illumination definition before comparing with planetary albedo.

sources.title: SoilGrids global gridded soil information
sources.scope: Predicted basic soil properties, depth intervals and prediction uncertainty.
limitations: Particle-size fractions are not mineral fractions.
SoilGrids alone cannot verify basalt, regolith-analog or volcanic-ash composition.
Preserve depth interval, unit conversion and uncertainty metadata; do not relabel these data as NASA measurements or Apache-2.0 content.

sources.title: Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature
sources.scope: Names, reference coordinates and approximate geographic extents of planetary features.
limitations: A feature center or approximate extent does not establish a NASA-approved landing site.
Preserve control network, planetographic/planetocentric convention, longitude direction and wrap convention.
No project ROI has been derived or exported from these references.

policy_references.scope: Original submissions must be freely available or OSI open source; Apache-2.0 is the stated default when no specific OSI license is given. This does not relicense third-party dependencies or data.
Resource attribution guidance for reused code, text and images.
